# U11: Real app: from empty to a filled-in workspace in four steps with its goals typed, the browser’s Back and a Change on Check return where they should, then a teammate joins

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `ONBOARDING`, `IDENTITY`, `DEMO-MODE`, `CHANGE-LOG`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As no one chosen yet, at `/` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 801

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser, with no one chosen yet.
- Go to `/` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- _Note:_ The empty real app explains itself and offers the demo, with one thing to do (Welcome, set-up spec 2.1).
- **Check:** “Run the company on outcomes, and manage by exception” is shown.
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “Look around the demo” link is visible (else: the empty app does not offer the demo).
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Set up a workspace” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “welcome”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Set up a workspace” link.
- **Check:** The step counter shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- Press the “Continue to people” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “Give the workspace a name” is visible (else: an empty name is not explained).
- **Step.** Type “Growth” into the “Workspace name” field.
- **Step.** Type “Rosa Lind” into the “Your name” field.
- **Step.** Type “Growth” into the “Your team” field.
- **Step.** Type “rosa.lind@example.com” into the “Your email” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to people” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/people”.
- **Check:** “Who’s on it?” is shown.
- _Note:_ The browser’s Back is the step before, with what was typed still there; Continue returns.
- Press the browser’s Back.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/workspace”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if the browser’s Back from People lost the workspace name.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to people” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/people”.
- Type “Omar Haddad” into the “Person 1: name” field.
- Type “omar.haddad@example.com” into the “Person 1: email” field.
- Type “Growth” into the “Person 1: team” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to goals” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/goals”.
- **Check:** “What are you working towards?” is shown.
- _Note:_ Three ways to start, none an example: the outcome and the goals feeding it are typed (ST2).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the goals step’s ways to start: {a value worked out in the journey}.
- **Check:** “What outcome are you after?” is shown.
- **Check:** It fails if the outcome starts filled in: there are no example goals.
- **Check:** “What feeds it?” is shown.
- Set-up's goals step, "Add your own" (`typeSetupGoals`).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “goals”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to check” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/check”.
- **Check:** “Create Growth?” is shown.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if Check is not “Step 4 of 4”.
- _Note:_ A Change on Check opens that step and comes back with Back to Check, which replaces Back.
- **Step.** Press the “Change people” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/people?from=check”.
- **Check:** The “Back to Check” button shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) it fails if a step opened from Check has “Back to Check” {fromCheck[0]}, and {fromCheck[1]} Back buttons.
- **Step.** Press the “Back to Check” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/check”.
- _Note:_ A name step 1 refuses can't reach Create another way (build review of #475): change it to "ab" on step 1, then open Check by its address (as the browser's Forward would) instead of Continue. Set-up goes back to step 1. A probe, not a step of the task, so its clicks are plain ones, as the empty-name check above.
- Press the “Change you” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/workspace”.
- Type “ab” into the “Workspace name” field.
- Go to `/workspace/new/check` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/workspace”.
- **Check:** (`entry`) it fails if a refused name reached by address: at {p.url()}, “Create ab?” shown {refused[1]} times.
- Type “Growth” into the “Workspace name” field.
- Press the “(Continue to people / Back to Check)” button.
- If the address doesn’t match “/check”:
  - Go to `/workspace/new/check` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/new/check”.
- **Step.** Press the “Create Growth” button.
- **Check:** “Growth is ready” is shown.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the main button in the celebrate (`.celebrate .btn.primary`) is visible (else: no next step after setting up).
